usdRate.sourceName: Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago, Economic DataPack September 2026, exchange rates: US dollar selling rate (monthly average)
usdRate.note: TT$6.7701 per US dollar, August 2026 average selling rate (6.7786 in August 2025); the rate has been managed near 6.77 for years. The Central Bank's daily selling rate was 6.7749 on 3 November 2026. World Bank 2025 average 6.75.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago, Monetary Policy Announcement 30 September 2026 (CSO Consumer Price Index)
inflation_cpi.note: Headline CPI inflation 0.6% year on year in July 2026 (food 1.7%, core 0.2%), the latest CSO figure cited by the Central Bank; the CSO page itself showed 0.3% for June 2026. World Bank 2025 average 1.0%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: CBTT Economic DataPack September 2026 (headline inflation 0.3-1.5% in 2024-2026); no formal inflation target
inflation_projection.note: The Central Bank does not target inflation; recent inflation is about 1% but the five-year average (2021-2025, including the 2022-2023 food-price spike) is near 2.5-3%, so planning uses 2.5%.

policy_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago, Monetary Policy Announcement: repo rate maintained at 3.50%
policy_rate.note: Repo rate held at 3.50% on 30 September 2026; it has been 3.50% since March 2020.

savings_account_rate.note: The Central Bank publishes only the weighted average deposit rate (0.92% in June 2026) and a fee schedule for savings accounts; no published typical rate for ordinary savings accounts was found.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No published average rate for 3-month time deposits was found; the Central Bank's Economic DataPack gives only the overall weighted average deposit rate (0.92%, June 2026).

fdr_1y_rate.note: No published average rate for 1-year time deposits was found; the Central Bank's Economic DataPack gives only the overall weighted average deposit rate (0.92%, June 2026).

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit product or published rate was found in Central Bank data.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago, Economic DataPack September 2026, Selected Interest Rates: commercial banks' weighted average deposit rate
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 0.92% in June 2026 (0.92% in March 2026, 0.80% in June 2025). World Bank deposit rate 1.5% (2025).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No separate government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found; the Central Bank says the public can buy ordinary government bonds at auction through Government Securities Intermediaries.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago, Economic DataPack September 2026, Trinidad and Tobago Government Treasury Yield Curve, 0.25-year tenor
tbill_91d_rate.note: 3.01% at end-August 2026 (2.77% in April 2026; 3-month OMO Treasury bill rate 3.01% in August 2026).

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago, Economic DataPack September 2026, Government Treasury Yield Curve, 5-year tenor

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago, Economic DataPack September 2026, Government Treasury Yield Curve, 10-year tenor

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Trinidad and Tobago, Individual, income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest received by a resident individual on savings or other accounts with banks and other deposit-taking institutions is exempt from tax (page reviewed 2 June 2026).

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists to tax; the tax treatment of interest on ordinary government bonds held by individuals could not be confirmed (PwC Tax Summaries mentions only the bank-interest exemption).

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Deposit Insurance Corporation of Trinidad and Tobago, deposit insurance coverage
deposit_insurance_limit.note: TT$200,000 per depositor per member institution in each right and capacity, Trinidad and Tobago dollar deposits only.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap on credit card interest was found; the Central Bank's October 2026 comparative schedule for credit cards lists fees only, not interest rates.

equity_return_low.sourceName: CBTT Economic DataPack: T&T Composite Index 1,016.7 in August 2026, up only 1.6% in a year
equity_return_low.note: Low case: the local index keeps drifting as it has since its 2020 peak, leaving only dividends.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Weak local index record; 3-month Treasury 3.01% and 1-year Treasury 4.59% (CBTT DataPack); bank interest tax-free
equity_return_base.note: The T&T Composite Index is lower than five years ago, so the base case is only about 2.5 points over the 3% Treasury bill rate, below the safe rate plus 4 points.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Local dividend yields plus recovery, or global equities in TT dollar terms (TT dollar near 6.77 per US dollar since 2017)
equity_return_high.note: High case: local shares recover or savers hold global equity funds, which in TT dollars track US dollar returns because the exchange rate is managed.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold about USD 3,900/oz at the start of November 2026, little changed in a year and well below its January 2026 peak of USD 5,608 (Trading Economics)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold stays flat in dollars and the managed TT dollar does not weaken.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold USD price trend (Trading Economics); TT dollar managed near 6.77 per US dollar (CBTT DataPack)
gold_return_base.note: Base case: gold tracks long-run dollar inflation plus a little, with the TT dollar broadly stable against the dollar.

gold_return_high.note: High case: gold resumes its 2020s uptrend or the TT dollar is devalued.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Commercial banks' weighted average deposit rate 0.92%, tax-free (CBTT DataPack June 2026)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: money left in bank deposits, which pay under 1% but are tax-free.

fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of short government securities and higher-paying deposits; tax on government security interest for individuals is not confirmed, so the figure stays near the bill rate.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: locking in five-year government bonds bought at auction through a securities intermediary.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The Central Bank supervises insurers under the Insurance Act 2018 but no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold in Trinidad and Tobago, but no regulator or other non-company source with indicative premiums by age was found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a private hospital stay was found; public hospitals under the Regional Health Authorities provide care at little or no charge.

health_premium_table.note: No regulator or other non-company source of private health insurance premiums by age was found.

oop_health_share.note: Out-of-pocket spending was 45.3% of current health expenditure in 2023 (latest available; older than 2025).

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: CBTT Economic DataPack September 2026: CPI health sub-index +0.9% year on year (July 2026)
goal_inflation_health.note: Measured health prices rose under 1% in the last year, but private medical costs and imported drugs tend to rise faster than the CPI, so planning uses 3%.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: CBTT Economic DataPack September 2026: CPI education sub-index unchanged at 102.5 (0.0% year on year)
goal_inflation_education.note: The CPI education index has been flat (public education is largely free), but private school and tertiary fees rise over time, so planning uses 3%.

life_expectancy.note: Men 70.5, women 76.8 (2024). UN WPP gives 73.9 for 2026.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years derived from the 'life expectancy by current age' table for 2026 (UN WPP): total age reached minus current age.

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 18.6 in 2025 (World Bank), 27.7 in 2040 and 49.5 in 2065 (UN WPP medium variant).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: National Insurance Board of Trinidad and Tobago, Retirement (Grant/Pension)
retirement_age_default.note: The NIS retirement pension can be claimed from 60 if retired from insurable employment, or at 65 whether retired or not, with at least 750 weekly contributions; the same rule applies to people born after 1975.

retirement_age_government.note: The compulsory retirement age for public servants could not be confirmed from an official page that could be read.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Commercial banks' weighted average deposit rate 0.92%, tax-free; 3-month Treasury 3.01% (CBTT DataPack)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: mostly bank deposits with some Treasury bills.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case: short government securities and term deposits, kept at the 3% Treasury bill rate.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: a ladder of one- to five-year government bonds.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Fixed income low 1%; equity low 1%; bonds 3-5%
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix of deposits, government bonds and equity funds.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half safe TT dollar fixed income and half equity funds.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case: equities do well and long bond yields stay near 5-6%.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: ttconnect (Government of Trinidad and Tobago), Senior Citizens' Pension
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Maximum TT$3,500 a month for people whose own monthly income is up to TT$2,500; it falls to TT$2,500, 1,500 and 500 for incomes up to TT$5,500, above which nothing is paid.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: ttconnect (Government of Trinidad and Tobago), Senior Citizens' Pension
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Age 65 or over, resident 20 consecutive years before applying (or 50 years in total), with monthly income not above TT$5,500.

gratuity_rule.note: The Retrenchment and Severance Benefits Act provides severance on retrenchment (redundancy), but its text could not be read from an official source and no statutory gratuity on retirement was confirmed.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: National Insurance Board of Trinidad and Tobago, Retirement (Grant/Pension)
public_pension_scheme.note: National Insurance is compulsory for employees. Pension from 60 (if retired from insurable employment) or 65 whether retired or not, with at least 750 weekly contributions; fewer contributions give a one-off retirement grant (minimum TT$3,000). The NIB page states no automatic indexation, so the pension is treated as not inflation-linked; tax treatment is not stated.

savings_account.note: Banks pay low rates; the weighted average deposit rate was 0.92% in June 2026. Interest is tax-free for residents.

fdr_3m.note: Time deposits are offered by banks; no average rate by term is published.

fdr_1y.note: Time deposits are offered by banks; no average rate by term is published.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was found in Central Bank data.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No separate retail savings certificate; individuals can buy ordinary government bonds at auction.

tbill_91d.note: Issued by the Central Bank for the government, mostly bought by institutions.

tbond_5y.note: The public can buy at auction, competitively or non-competitively, through Government Securities Intermediaries.

tbond_10y.note: The public can buy at auction through Government Securities Intermediaries.

equity_fund.note: Equity funds held TT$8.1 billion in June 2026 (CBTT DataPack).

gold.note: No legal restriction on owning gold was found; there is no local exchange-traded gold market.

centralBank.name: Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago

insuranceRegulator.name: Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago, insurance sector supervision

insuranceComplaints.name: Office of the Financial Services Ombudsman (OFSO)

pensionScheme.name: National Insurance Board of Trinidad and Tobago (NIBTT), retirement pension

oldAgeAllowance.name: Senior Citizens' Pension (Ministry of Social Development and Family Services)

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health, accessing public healthcare (Regional Health Authorities)

depositInsurance.name: Deposit Insurance Corporation of Trinidad and Tobago
